stage0067_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Hey, $$宗介$$!
　Here to help $$キリコ$$ too?」

stage0067_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ココナ$$
「If you were coming, you should've come sooner.
　The work's already pretty much done.」

stage0067_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$宗介$$
「So this is a custom variant of the $$スコープドッグ$$...」

stage0067_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Nicknamed the $$バーグラリードッグ$$.
　Great mobility over rough terrain, and its
　frontal and top attack power is guaranteed.」

stage0067_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「A so-called assault variant, I'd say.
　Perfect fit for this mission.」

stage0067_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Add $$キリコ$$'s skill and
　how smitten he is for $$フィアナ$$,
　and you've got invincible.」

stage0067_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$キリコ$$ himself doesn't seem to think so, though.」

stage0067_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「All that's left is tuning the $$ミッションディスク$$.
　You'll have to handle that yourself.」

stage0067_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$バニラ$$
「That's cold, old man.
　Let's give him a hand.」

stage0067_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ココナ$$
「$$キリコ$$ wants to focus before the mission too.
　Just leave him be.」

stage0067_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$バニラ$$
「A-alright...!
　I said alright, quit pulling me!」

stage0067_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「See you, $$キリコ$$.
　We'll be watching $$フィアナ$$'s rescue too.」

stage0067_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Sleep's important prep too.
　Hurry up and finish, then get some rest.」

stage0067_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't intend to disturb your focus.
　So let me say just one thing.」

stage0067_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$宗介$$
「I want to learn your strength.
　...That's all.」

stage0067_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Seems he's hit a wall too.」

stage0067_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$相良宗介$$...
　What do you make of him?」

stage0067_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I've no time to spare for others right now.」

stage0067_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Quite right.
　Seems I asked a pointless question.」

stage0067_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Consider this my apology.
　I'll help tune the $$ミッションディスク$$.」

stage0067_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「The situation's different from back then.
　I'll adjust the customization to match.」

stage0067_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Also, this may sound like an excuse,
　but with you, whether I wear the mask
　or not wouldn't make a difference.」

stage0067_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text: ～ $$マーティアル$$ Order HQ, Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$' Office ～

stage0067_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ノスコビッツ$$
「...We ask that you explain how you
　came to contact the 'Untouchable,' Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.」

stage0067_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I see...
　So you mean to expose scandal about me,
　your greatest rival before the papal election...?」

stage0067_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Lord $$グノー$$, do you want the next $$法皇$$'s seat
　that badly?」

stage0067_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$グノー$$
「Do not misunderstand me, Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.
　I merely wish to bring the truth to light.」

stage0067_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$グノー$$
「The last abnormal... a cursed bringer of ruin...
　To touch $$キリコ・キュービィー$$
　would shake the very existence of the Order...」

stage0067_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$グノー$$
「That is why His Holiness $$法皇$$ Theo VIII
　surely decreed him taboo as the 'Untouchable.'」

stage0067_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ノスコビッツ$$
「Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, having laid hands on that,
　cannot complain if he's branded a heretic.」

stage0067_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
（$$グノー$$'s lackey is quite desperate too...）

stage0067_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$グノー$$
「Now then, Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$...
　if you have an explanation, let us hear it.」

stage0067_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...What I love above all else is order.」

stage0067_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ノスコビッツ$$
「Breaking the taboo yourself, and yet...」

stage0067_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Order is the will of God,
　and it is upheld by strength alone.」

stage0067_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$グノー$$
「'$$マーティアル$$ is the harmony of all things...'
　A line from $$マーティアル$$'s doctrine, is it not.」

stage0067_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「To honor that truth, for ages long past,
　has $$マーティアル$$ not upheld the martial spirit?」

stage0067_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「And we cannot allow that monster $$キリコ$$
　to remain untouched as the 'Untouchable.'」

stage0067_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I understand your fear as well.
　You worry that clumsily meddling with $$キリコ$$
　will bring about disaster, yes?」

stage0067_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「But he is merely one soldier, after all.
　There is no way we of mighty $$マーティアル$$
　could be shaken by a single man.」

stage0067_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ノスコビッツ$$
「That may be true, but...」

stage0067_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Besides, if we simply erase him,
　every worry will be resolved.
　There is no need to fret.」

stage0067_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ノスコビッツ$$
「Even $$ＰＳ$$ could not defeat that man!
　In other words, the $$ＰＳ$$ Project
　was practically crushed by him!」

stage0067_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$ＰＳ$$ is a being that ignores humanity
　upheld by faith. They were taught only
　the urge to attack, and thus lost sight of God.」

stage0067_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「But the $$ネクスタント$$ is fundamentally different.」

stage0067_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$グノー$$
「Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$'s daughter, Lady $$テイタニア$$, is it...」

stage0067_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「To a $$ネクスタント$$'s innate mind,
　we granted what is called an auxiliary brain,
　which supports and enhances combat ability.」

stage0067_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「That auxiliary brain is the golden mind that safeguards our faith.」

stage0067_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ノスコビッツ$$
「We have reports that $$テイタニア$$ provoked $$キリコ$$
　and lured him here to $$アレギウム$$.」

stage0067_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「If $$キリコ$$ and his allies come to the
　holy land of $$アレギウム$$, my daughter $$テイタニア$$
　shall defeat the 'Untouchable' before your eyes.」

stage0067_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「And $$マーティアル$$, freed from
　$$キリコ・キュービィー$$'s curse, shall walk
　a new age under a new $$法皇$$.」

stage0067_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
（It's futile, $$グノー$$.
　The next $$法皇$$ is already all but decided to be me.）

stage0067_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
（Even if $$キリコ$$ and the others appear in $$アレギウム$$,
　if the entire defense force is mobilized, not even
　they will stand a chance.）

stage0067_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
（In other words, no one remains who can stop me.）

stage0067_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$ロッチナ$$, is it...」

stage0067_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I've heard of your success in $$ヘルマジスタン$$.
　Seems you lured $$キリコ$$ here to $$アレギウム$$.」

stage0067_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「A performance to put your father, Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$,
　on the papal seat, perhaps?」

stage0067_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「What are you trying to say?」

stage0067_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「You may fool Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$,
　but you cannot deceive my eyes, $$テイタニア$$.」

stage0067_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「You have been captured by a man named $$キリコ$$.
　That is why you cannot control your own actions.」

stage0067_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「There is no way that I
　would be moved by a man like that.」

stage0067_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Don't talk about him as if you know him.
　Especially not in front of me, $$ロッチナ$$.」

stage0067_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I am not blaming you.
　Heh... quite the opposite, actually.」

stage0067_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I am the same as you...
　for I too am a man whose heart $$キリコ$$ has stolen.」

stage0067_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Do you intend to go see $$フィアナ$$?」

stage0067_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$ desires that woman.
　I want to speak with her before our showdown.」

stage0067_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「What right do you have to interfere with my actions...!」

stage0067_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Heheh... I knew it, you are the same as I.
　You're jealous of that woman... of $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0067_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「As one drawn to $$キリコ$$.
　And doubly so, as a woman!
　No, triply so, as a human weapon!」

stage0067_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$ＰＳ$$ and I are different!
　That woman had $$キリコ$$ imprinted on her blank brain!
　But I am not like that!」

stage0067_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「My mind remains as it was born!
　After my accident, to save my life,
　my father remade me as a $$ネクスタント$$!」

stage0067_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「This auxiliary brain in my chest
　is nothing more than a combat data processor!」

stage0067_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Quite right.
　That's the decisive difference between a $$ＰＳ$$,
　whose own brain is the combat system, and a $$ネクスタント$$.」

stage0067_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「So let me offer one piece of advice.
　It was because $$フィアナ$$'s own brain was altered
　that she suffered stress, and could recognize it.」

stage0067_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「But no matter how hard you push your mind,
　a $$ネクスタント$$ relying on an auxiliary brain
　can't recognize its own pain. Isn't that dangerous?」

stage0067_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Heh... going to wake $$フィアナ$$, are you...
　without even knowing what the result will be.」

stage0067_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Come then, $$キリコ$$.
　Show me whether your $$異能生存体$$ factor
　can overcome fate.」

stage0067_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text: ～ $$マーティアル$$ Order HQ, Medical Facility ～

stage0067_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
Medical Staff
「Lady $$テイタニア$$, please reconsider.
　That woman is a $$ＰＳ$$ developed by the Gilgamesh Army.」

stage0067_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Are you saying this woman's illness cannot be cured?」

stage0067_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
Medical Staff
「All we can do now is suppress her metabolism
　in near cryo-sleep, and halt the disease's progress...」

stage0067_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
Medical Staff
「Without access to the Gilgamesh Army's research data,
　this is the best we can manage.」

stage0067_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I am $$テイタニア$$ $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$,
　Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$' daughter!」

stage0067_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（$$キリコ$$... you're probably on your way here,
　drawn to this $$フィアナ$$ like a magnet...）

stage0067_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（But all that awaits here is a decisive battle with me）

stage0067_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（If you win, you can get the woman back.
　But if you lose, all that awaits is death...
　At least you'd want to see her once before you die）

stage0067_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（This settles the debt from when you spared me）

stage0067_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
Medical Staff
「...Resuscitation complete.
　She'll regain consciousness shortly.」

stage0067_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Do you know me, $$フィアナ$$?」

stage0067_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$ will be here soon.」

stage0067_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「But I'm the one who'll defeat $$キリコ$$.
　See him through to his death.」

stage0067_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「You too... are just like me...」

stage0067_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「No!
　I'm not a $$ＰＳ$$!
　I'm a $$ネクスタント$$!」

stage0067_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「And at the very least, I'm $$キリコ$$'s enemy!
　I will defeat him!」

stage0067_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「You really aren't an ordinary person...」

stage0067_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「If you say you'll defeat $$キリコ$$, it can't be helped...
　But... even so... love him...」

stage0067_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「You heard His Holiness the $$法皇$$'s own words.」

stage0067_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「His Holiness has named this $$ヴィアチェスラフ・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
　as his successor, the 713th $$法皇$$.」

stage0067_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ノスコビッツ$$
「O-objection!
　Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ has broken a taboo!」

stage0067_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Silence, $$ノスコビッツ$$!
　And you as well, $$グノー$$!」

stage0067_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「If you defy His Holiness the $$法皇$$'s decision,
　then you're the ones who defy God's will.」

stage0067_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Then, Your Holiness...
　give the robe that marks the $$法皇$$... to me...」

stage0067_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$法皇$$
（So you've finally come this far, $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.
　But there is no faith here...）

stage0067_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
（But there is power.
　More to rely on than miracles...）

stage0067_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$法皇$$
（So you sacrificed your daughter as a human weapon...）

stage0067_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
（That was an accident）

stage0067_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$法皇$$
（Well, no matter...
　At this point, it makes no difference）

stage0067_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「The formal coronation will be held at a later date!」

stage0067_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「As the new $$法皇$$, I wield supreme command,
　and I order $$テイタニア$$, Shield of Order!」

stage0067_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Whoever would defile this $$アレギウム$$
　must never be forgiven, whoever they are!」

stage0067_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Swiftly eliminate any who set foot on this land,
　and see to the defense of the $$アレギウム$$!」

stage0067_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「As you command, Your Holiness.」

stage0067_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（Father...
　Is this the thing you wanted to gain...）

stage0067_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Did they do something to you!?」

stage0067_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「That's...not it...
　Ever since...I was brought here...
　I've been...asleep...this whole time...」

stage0067_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「If I hadn't, my body wouldn't have lasted...」

stage0067_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「...I'm...sorry...$$キリコ$$...
　I can't...go on living...with you...anymore...」

stage0067_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「This is...the lifespan I got...from being
　made into a $$ＰＳ$$...it seems...」

stage0067_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't die, $$フィアナ$$!
　If time stops, lifespan won't matter anymore!」

stage0067_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Even if I have to fight the whole world, for you...!
　I'll...!」

stage0067_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「No...$$キリコ$$...
　this world...isn't...just ours...alone...」

stage0067_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「So...turn this world...into one without war...」

stage0067_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「I'm glad...I got to meet...you...」

stage0067_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text: $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room

stage0067_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text: $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room

stage0067_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text: $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room

stage0067_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0067_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Let me thank you for answering my call, $$ゼロ$$.」

stage0067_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「How did you get into $$蜃気楼$$'s private channel?」

stage0067_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「You should already know the answer to that.
　That's why you answered my call.」

stage0067_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「You must sense it too, if only vaguely.
　That a new era is about to begin...」

stage0067_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Yes... the Age of God.」

stage0067_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$バニラ$$
「So, well...
　it's just...there was nothing to be done...」

stage0067_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I understand you mean well...
　but let's leave him be for now.」

stage0067_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「There's nothing to say to him right now.」

stage0067_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$n
「To heal a wound...there's only time...
　Bear it...alone...」

stage0067_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Everyone, report to the briefing room.
　Our next destination has been decided.」

stage0067_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Hong Kong.
　There's movement from Amalgam there.」

stage0067_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$刹那$$
「...Let's go.
　We have no choice but to fight.」

stage0067_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$キリコ$$
（A world without fighting...
　All that's left to me are $$フィアナ$$'s final words...）

stage0067_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That's what $$フィアナ$$ and I were searching for.
　We believed that there, we could find
　peace and comfort...）

stage0067_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$フィアナ$$ left that wish in my hands.
　But in a world without her, what does that mean...）

stage0067_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$キリコ$$
（Even so, I'll keep fighting...
　because I know no other way to live）

stage0067_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Seems you've noticed, about $$マーティアル$$'s god.」

stage0067_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Still just a vague image, though.」

stage0067_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「In the 《$$黄昏の間$$》, briefly,
　you touched the 《$$集合無意識$$》.」

stage0067_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So the fragmented knowledge inside me,
　like an image, is its influence...」

stage0067_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The 《$$ギアス嚮団$$》 no longer exists.
　How you use their legacy is up to you.」

stage0067_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Very well.
　When the time comes, I'll make that my strength too.」

stage0067_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（I'm not quite sure what that means,
　but this probably isn't the end with $$マーティアル$$...）

stage0067_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（But thanks to Master $$ゼロ$$, Master $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$,
　and Master $$シャッコ$$, we got about 100Z in Z-Chips）

stage0067_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Naturally, that'll belong to the squad, won't it.」

stage0067_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't get any funny ideas, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I want to get along with you, after all.」

stage0067_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This whole thing seems to have shocked you.」

stage0067_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The pain of failing to protect someone precious...
　That's not something I'd want to feel.」

stage0067_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Seems it had quite the opposite effect, after all...」

stage0067_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At this rate, Master $$宗介$$... will you never resurface...?」

stage0067_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I can't muster my usual enthusiasm today.
　I'll save the celebration for the ace pilot
　for another time.」

stage0067_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「D-Trader is open for business, so feel free to stop by.」
